text: CSV Profiler: Conservative Typing & Zero Protection
textPreview: CSV Profiler: Conservative Typing & Zero Protection

text:
● Reads column headers and samples up to 200 rows.
● int/float/datetime require 100% uniformity in samples.
● Leading zero detection (_has_leading_zero): forces columns with leading zeros (e.g., '0123') to string to preserve codes.
● Falls back to string on any parsing conflict to avoid over-claiming physical structures.

text: JSON Profiler: Traversal & Declared Schemas
textPreview: JSON Profiler: Traversal & Declared Schemas

text:
● Bounds file ingestion (16MB) to ensure memory safety.
● Declared Mode: Crawls standard JSON Schema properties to generate declared claims; validates samples.
● Observed Mode: Flattens dynamic trees using a recursive visit(val, path, index) to track paths (e.g., $.store.book[]).
● Records column nullability without guessing semantics.
